import subprocess as s, os, json, pathlib, hashlib, time
w=pathlib.Path('/tmp/wt-perf-10000'); e=pathlib.Path('/tmp/core-st-performance-10000-20261028')
e.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
os.chdir(w)
os.environ.update(PATH='/tmp/uvenv/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],UV_CACHE_DIR='/tmp/uv-cache-perf-r20',MEMORY_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT='http://127.0.0.1:18049',MEMORY_RERANKER_ENDPOINT='http://127.0.0.1:18050',MEMORY_CORE_ST_EVIDENCE_DIR=str(e))
c=['docker','compose','-p','memory-core-perf-10000-20261028','-f','compose.core-st.yml','-f','compose.core-st.performance.yml']
def run(a, log):
 print('running',log,flush=True)
 with (e/log).open('w') as f:
  p=s.run(a,stdout=f,stderr=s.STDOUT)
 (e/(log+'.exit')).write_text(str(p.returncode))
 if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError((a,p.returncode,log))
def out(a): return s.check_output(a,text=True).strip()
mroot=pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser('~/.local/share/digital-souls-memory/models'))
expected=json.loads((w/'docs/reports/core-st-performance-manifest.template.json').read_text())
for key,file in [('embedding','bge-m3-q8_0.gguf'),('reranker','bge-reranker-v2-m3-Q8_0.gguf')]:
 digest=hashlib.file_digest((mroot/file).open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
 assert digest==expected[key]['sha256'], (key,digest)
(e/'model-digests.json').write_text(json.dumps({key:expected[key]['sha256'] for key in ['embedding','reranker']}))
assert not out(['docker','ps','-aq','--filter','label=com.docker.compose.project=memory-core-perf-10000-20261028'])
for name in ['embedding','reranker']:
 assert not out(['docker','ps','-aq','--filter','name=^/memory-core-perf-10000-'+name+'$'])
run(['nvidia-smi'],'gpu.txt')
run(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}} {{.Image}}'],'background-containers.txt')
run(c+['build','postgres','init'],'build.log')
image='sha256:69019445c94c970496c8f6d6447214b837508162dfe1152768942c51237e3ab7'
for name,port,file,pool,extra in [('embedding',18049,'bge-m3-q8_0.gguf','cls',[]),('reranker',18050,'bge-reranker-v2-m3-Q8_0.gguf','rank',['--reranking'])]:
 run(['docker','run','-d','--name',f'memory-core-perf-10000-{name}','--gpus','all','-p',f'127.0.0.1:{port}:8080','-v',os.path.expanduser('~/.local/share/digital-souls-memory/models')+':/models:ro',image,'--model','/models/'+file,'--host','0.0.0.0','--port','8080','--ctx-size','2048','--batch-size','2048','--ubatch-size','2048','--parallel','1','--n-gpu-layers','99','--threads','8','--threads-batch','8','--cache-ram','0','--embeddings','--pooling',pool]+extra,f'{name}-start.log')
for port in [18049,18050]:
 for _ in range(120):
  if s.run(['curl','-sf',f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health'],stdout=s.DEVNULL).returncode==0: break
  time.sleep(1)
 else: raise RuntimeError('model not healthy')
run(c+['up','-d','--no-build','--wait','memory'],'start.log')
db=out(c+['ps','-q','postgres']); mem=out(c+['ps','-q','memory'])
q=['docker','exec',db,'psql','-U','memory_st_admin','-d','memory_core_st','-Atc']
version=out(q+["SELECT version(); SELECT extname,extversion FROM pg_extension; SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version;"])
(e/'db-version.txt').write_text(version)
m=json.loads((w/'docs/reports/2026-10-26-core-st-performance-after-r20-summary.json').read_text())['performance']['manifest']
m.update(data_counts=[100,1000,10000],revision=out(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']),db_image=out(['docker','inspect',db,'--format','{{.Image}}']),client_image=out(['docker','inspect',mem,'--format','{{.Image}}']),db_version=version,period=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d UTC; exact timestamps recorded in performance.json',time.gmtime()))
(e/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(e/'manifest-before.sha256').write_text(hashlib.sha256((e/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
files=['tests/st/performance.py','tests/st/support.py','tests/st/latency.py','tools/core_st_db.py','compose.core-st.yml','compose.core-st.performance.yml']
(e/'source-hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({f:hashlib.sha256((w/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files},indent=2))
run(['docker','exec',mem,'sha256sum']+files[:4],'image-source-hashes.txt')
run(['docker','inspect','memory-core-perf-10000-embedding','memory-core-perf-10000-reranker','--format','{{json .Config.Cmd}} {{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}} {{.Image}}'],'model-inspect.txt')
with (e/'runner.log').open('w') as f: p=s.run(c+['run','--no-deps','--rm','runner'],stdout=f,stderr=s.STDOUT)
(e/'runner-exit.txt').write_text(str(p.returncode)+'\n')
run(['docker','logs','--timestamps',mem],'memory.log')
character=out(q+["SELECT DISTINCT owner_id FROM recall_documents WHERE ready;"])
(e/'ready.txt').write_text(out(q+["SELECT owner_id,count(*) FROM recall_documents WHERE ready GROUP BY owner_id;"]))
code = """import json,time
from digital_souls_memory.client import MemoryClient
samples=[]
with MemoryClient(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:18039',timeout=30,author_token='synthetic-st-credential') as c:
 for i in range(5):
  t=time.perf_counter()
  try:
   values=c.list_memories(CHARACTER)
   samples.append(dict(attempt=i+1,elapsed_s=time.perf_counter()-t,count=len(values),status='PASS' if len(values)==10000 else 'FAIL',error=None))
  except Exception as error:
   samples.append(dict(attempt=i+1,elapsed_s=time.perf_counter()-t,count=None,status='FAIL',error=type(error).__name__,cause=type(error.__cause__).__name__ if error.__cause__ else None))
print(json.dumps(dict(samples=samples,timeout_s=30,measurement='MemoryClient.list_memories; GET through full typed response; five consecutive calls after runner')))
""".replace('CHARACTER',repr(character))
run(['docker','exec',mem,'python','-c',code],'list-timing.json')
run(['docker','logs','--timestamps',mem],'memory-after-list.log')
print('runner exit',p.returncode,flush=True)

import subprocess as sp,json,pathlib,os
w=pathlib.Path('/tmp/wt-perf-10000');e=pathlib.Path('/tmp/core-st-performance-10000-20261028')
os.chdir(w)
os.environ.update(MEMORY_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT='http://127.0.0.1:18049',MEMORY_RERANKER_ENDPOINT='http://127.0.0.1:18050',MEMORY_CORE_ST_EVIDENCE_DIR=str(e))
project='memory-core-perf-10000-20261028'
models=['memory-core-perf-10000-embedding','memory-core-perf-10000-reranker']
with (e/'cleanup-st.log').open('w') as f:sp.run(['docker','compose','-p',project,'-f','compose.core-st.yml','-f','compose.core-st.performance.yml','down','--volumes','--remove-orphans'],stdout=f,stderr=sp.STDOUT,check=True)
with (e/'cleanup-models.log').open('w') as f:sp.run(['docker','rm','-f']+models,stdout=f,stderr=sp.STDOUT,check=True)
r=dict(status='PASS',project=project)
for key,cmd in [('containers',['docker','ps','-aq']),('networks',['docker','network','ls','-q']),('volumes',['docker','volume','ls','-q'])]:
 r[key]=sp.check_output(cmd+['--filter','label=com.docker.compose.project='+project],text=True).split();assert not r[key]

for name in models:r['model_containers']+=sp.check_output(['docker','ps','-aq','--filter','name=^/'+name+'$'],text=True).split()

(e/'cleanup.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(r))
